scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Their ignorance shaking the earth's foundations (5); the sentence on the 'sons of the Most High' (6-7); 'Arise, O God, judge the earth' (8).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 83 – O God, Be Not Silent
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Plea against a coalition bent on erasing Israel's name — 'let us erase them as a nation.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 83 – The Alliance Against You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The roll of conspirators from Edom and Moab to Tyre and Assyria, joined against God; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 83 – Do to Them as to Midian
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Appeal to past victories — Sisera, Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna who coveted God's pastures.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 83 – Like Chaff Before the Wind
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Imprecation that they be whirled like tumbleweed and pursued with God's tempest and storm.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 83 – That They May Know Your Name
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The redemptive aim of the judgment: that the shamed nations seek and know the LORD as Most High over all the earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 84 – How Lovely Is Your Dwelling Place
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pilgrim longing for the courts of the LORD, where even the sparrow nests by His altars; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 84 – From Strength to Strength
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Blessed are the pilgrims who turn the Valley of Baca into springs, going on until they appear before God in Zion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 84 – Look on the Face of Your Anointed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The pilgrim's prayer for the king-shield, addressed to the LORD God of Hosts; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 84 – Better Is One Day in Your Courts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Better a doorkeeper in God's house than dwelling with the wicked, for 'the LORD God is a sun and shield.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 85 – You Restored Jacob from Captivity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Communal thanksgiving for past favor: forgiven iniquity, withdrawn fury; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 85 – Will You Be Angry Forever?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The turn to petition: 'Restore us… revive us again… show us Your loving devotion.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 85 – He Will Speak Peace to His People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Listening for God's word of peace, His salvation near to those who fear Him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 85 – Righteousness and Peace Have Kissed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The beautiful meeting of love, faithfulness, righteousness, and peace, with the land yielding its increase.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – Incline Your Ear, O LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: David's prayer of the poor and godly servant who lifts up his soul and trusts in his God.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – Kind and Forgiving
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Confidence in the God rich in devotion who answers in the day of distress.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – There Is None Like You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The vision of all nations coming to bow before the one true God who alone does wonders.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – Give Me an Undivided Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The great petition to walk in God's truth with a unified heart, praising Him who delivered from Sheol's depths.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – Slow to Anger, Abounding in Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ruthless band that seeks his life (14) answered by the Exodus-creed of God's compassion (15).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 86 – Show Me a Sign of Your Goodness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing plea for strength and a token of favor that his enemies may see and be ashamed.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 87 – Glorious Things of You Are Spoken
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Zion-hymn: the city founded on the holy mountains, loved by the LORD above all dwellings of Jacob; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 87 – This One Was Born in Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The nations — Rahab, Babylon, Philistia, Tyre, Cush — registered as Zion's citizens; 'all my springs of joy are in You'; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – Day and Night I Cry Before You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The darkest psalm opens: a soul full of troubles, life drawing near to Sheol.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – Forsaken Among the Dead
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Counted with those in the Pit, laid in the lowest depths, Your wrath like submerging waves; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – You Have Removed My Friends
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Made repulsive to companions, confined, eyes dim with grief — yet daily spreading out his hands to God.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – Do You Work Wonders for the Dead?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The threefold question whether God's love and faithfulness can be known in the grave; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – Why Do You Hide Your Face?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Morning prayer met with rejection, afflicted from youth and bearing God's terrors in despair.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 88 – Darkness Is My Closest Companion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unrelieved close: wrath sweeping over him, friend and beloved removed, only darkness remaining.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – I Will Sing of the LORD's Devotion Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Ethan's covenant-psalm opens with the oath to David: 'I will establish your offspring forever.'; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Who in the Skies Compares with the LORD?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The heavens praising His faithfulness; God feared in the council of the holy ones — 'who is like You?'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – You Crushed Rahab
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Creator-King who stills the raging sea and scatters His enemies with His mighty arm.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Righteousness Is Your Throne's Foundation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Heaven and earth His, Tabor and Hermon rejoicing, righteousness and devotion going before Him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Blessed Are Those Who Know the Joyful Sound
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The blessing of those who walk in the light of His presence, their horn and shield belonging to the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – I Have Found My Servant David
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The vision recalled: God's anointing and sustaining of the chosen warrior-king.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – No Enemy Will Oppress Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The covenant promises of protection and an exalted horn through God's name.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – My Firstborn, the Highest of Kings
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: David's hand set over sea and rivers, calling God 'my Father,' appointed highest of earth's kings.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – His Throne as Long as the Heavens
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The everlasting covenant and the line established forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – The Rod for His Sons' Transgression
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The conditional warning: if his sons forsake the law, He will visit their sin with the rod.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – I Will Not Violate My Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unbreakable pledge: devotion never withdrawn, the utterance of His lips never altered.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Established Forever Like the Moon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The oath by His holiness — David's throne a faithful witness in the sky; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – But Now You Have Spurned Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The bitter turn: the covenant seemingly renounced, the crown sullied, his walls broken down.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – All Who Pass By Plunder Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The anointed a reproach, his foes exalted, his sword's edge turned back in battle.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – His Throne Cast to the Ground
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His splendor ended and his youth cut short, covered with shame; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – How Long Will You Hide Yourself?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cry against God's hidden wrath and the brevity of life — 'what man can live and never see death?'; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Where Is Your Devotion of Old?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing appeal to the oath sworn to David and the reproach heaped on the steps of His anointed.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 89 – Blessed Be the LORD Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The doxology that closes Book III: 'Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.'

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Psalms 90–106 answer Book III's crisis with the proclamation 'YHWH reigns!' (93, 96, 97, 99). Opens with Moses' psalm (90) contrasting God's eternality and human frailty; ends with explicit doxology at 106:48. Literary Glue: the Enthronement Psalms form the theological core.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – From Everlasting to Everlasting
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer of Moses opens Book IV: the eternal God our dwelling place before the mountains were born.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – You Return Man to Dust
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The contrast of God's timelessness with human transience — a thousand years like a day, men like morning grass.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – Our Years End with a Sigh
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Consumed by God's anger, secret sins exposed, the span of life seventy years of labor and sorrow.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – Teach Us to Number Our Days
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wisdom-petition at the psalm's heart: to count our days that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – Satisfy Us in the Morning
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The turn to mercy: 'Return, O LORD… satisfy us with Your loving devotion' for as many days as we have seen evil.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 90 – Establish the Work of Our Hands
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing prayer that God's favor rest on His servants and confirm their labor.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 91 – In the Shadow of the Almighty
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The psalm of refuge: dwelling in the secret place, covered with His feathers, His faithfulness a shield.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 91 – You Will Not Fear the Terror of Night
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No fear of arrow, pestilence, or noonday calamity; thousands may fall, but no harm comes near.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 91 – No Evil Will Befall You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Because the LORD is your dwelling, no plague will approach your tent.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 91 – He Will Command His Angels
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The promise of angelic guarding (cited at Christ's temptation): you will tread on lion and cobra.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 91 – With Long Life I Will Satisfy Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's own voice closes the psalm: deliverance and honor for the one who loves and knows His name.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 92 – A Song for the Sabbath
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: It is good to praise the LORD morning and night with harp and lyre.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 92 – How Deep Are Your Thoughts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Gladness in God's works, beyond the grasp of the senseless and the fool.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 92 – The Wicked Sprout Like Grass
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Though evildoers flourish, they are destined for destruction, for the LORD is exalted forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 92 – My Horn Exalted Like a Wild Ox
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Anointed with fresh oil, the psalmist sees the downfall of his foes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 92 – The Righteous Flourish Like a Palm
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Planted in the house of the LORD, still bearing fruit in old age — 'the LORD is upright… my Rock.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 93 – The LORD Reigns, Robed in Majesty
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The first enthronement psalm: the established world and the eternal throne; above the roar of the seas the LORD on high is majestic, and holiness adorns His house.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – O God of Vengeance, Shine Forth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Appeal to the Judge of the earth: 'how long will the wicked exult?'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – They Crush Your People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The arrogance of the oppressors who kill the widow and orphan, saying 'the LORD does not see.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – He Who Formed the Eye, Can He Not See?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wisdom-rebuke to the senseless: the Maker of ear and eye knows the futile thoughts of man.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – Blessed Is the Man You Discipline
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The blessing of God's instruction, for the LORD will not forsake His people to a dug pit.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – Your Consolation Delights My Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: When the foot slips and anxiety overwhelms, the LORD's devotion supports and His comfort delights.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 94 – The LORD Is My Rock of Refuge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No corrupt throne can ally with God; He will repay the wicked their own iniquity.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 95 – The Rock of Our Salvation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Call to sing and shout to the great King above all gods.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 95 – The Sea Is His, for He Made It
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Creator who holds the depths of the earth and the mountain peaks in His hand.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 95 – The Sheep of His Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Worship and kneel before our Maker — 'Today, if you hear His voice…'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 95 – Do Not Harden Your Hearts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The warning of Meribah and Massah (quoted in Hebrews): the generation barred from God's rest.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 96 – Sing to the LORD a New Song
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Universal summons to declare His glory and salvation among all the nations.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 96 – The Gods of the Nations Are Idols
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Great is the LORD above all gods, the Maker of the heavens, splendor in His sanctuary.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 96 – Worship in the Splendor of Holiness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The families of nations called to ascribe glory, bring offerings, and tremble before Him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 96 – He Comes to Judge the Earth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'The LORD reigns!' — heavens, sea, fields, and trees rejoice before the coming Judge of righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 97 – The LORD Reigns, Let the Earth Rejoice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Enthronement amid cloud and darkness; fire goes before Him to consume His foes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 97 – The Mountains Melt Like Wax
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The theophany: lightning, trembling earth, melting mountains, and the heavens proclaiming His righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 97 – Zion Hears and Rejoices
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Idolaters put to shame while Zion exults, for the LORD is Most High over all the earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 97 – Light Shines on the Righteous
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The call to hate evil and rejoice in the LORD who preserves and delivers His saints.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 98 – His Holy Arm Has Won the Victory
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A new song for the salvation revealed to the nations and the ends of the earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 98 – Shout for Joy Before the King
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The orchestra of praise: lyre, harp, trumpets, and ram's horn before the LORD, the King.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 98 – Let the Rivers Clap Their Hands
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Sea, rivers, and mountains summoned to rejoice before the coming Judge of the world.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 99 – Enthroned Above the Cherubim
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The LORD reigns and the nations tremble; great in Zion — 'He is holy!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 99 – The Mighty King Loves Justice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Equity established in Jacob; Moses, Aaron, and Samuel among those who called and were answered.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 99 – Worship at His Holy Mountain
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The God who spoke from the pillar of cloud, forgiving yet avenging — 'the LORD our God is holy.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 100 – Make a Joyful Noise, All the Earth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The complete thanksgiving processional: know the LORD is God and Maker, enter His gates with thanks, for His devotion endures forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 101 – I Will Walk with Integrity of Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The king's covenant of conduct: singing of devotion and justice, setting no worthless thing before his eyes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 101 – I Will Cut Off Every Evildoer
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The vow to silence slanderers and the proud, favoring the faithful and purging the city of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – Hear My Prayer, O LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The afflicted one's lament opens: 'do not hide Your face… answer me quickly when I call.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – My Days Vanish Like Smoke
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wasting of body and soul — bones burning like embers, heart withered like grass.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – Like a Lone Bird on a Housetop
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The imagery of desolate isolation: a desert owl among the ruins, sleepless and alone.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – Ashes Like Bread
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Taunted by enemies, eating ashes and mixing tears, cast aside by God's indignation.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – But You, O LORD, Sit Enthroned Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The great turn from self to the eternal King who will rise and have compassion on Zion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – The LORD Will Rebuild Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The nations and kings fearing His glory when He appears and answers the prayer of the destitute.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – Written for a Generation to Come
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The record for the unborn, of the God who looked down to hear the prisoner's groaning.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – That They May Proclaim His Name in Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The gathered peoples and kingdoms assembling to serve the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – Do Not Take Me in the Midst of My Days
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The return to lament, set against the God whose years go on through all generations.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 102 – You Remain the Same
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The creation-eternity of God (cited of the Son in Heb 1): heaven and earth wear out, but He endures and His servants' children are established.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – Bless the LORD, O My Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The summons of the soul to bless His holy name and forget none of His benefits.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – Who Forgives All Your Iniquities
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cascade of benefits: forgiveness, healing, redemption, devotion, and renewed youth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – Slow to Anger, Abounding in Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His ways made known to Moses; the Exodus-creed of the compassionate and gracious LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – As Far as the East from the West
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: He has not repaid us by our sins; His devotion as high as heaven, our transgressions removed beyond measure.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – He Knows Our Frame
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A father's compassion on those who fear Him, mindful that we are dust.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – His Devotion from Everlasting to Everlasting
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Man's days like a flower of the field, but the LORD's love everlasting to those who keep His covenant.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 103 – Bless the LORD, All His Works
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His throne in heaven and kingdom over all; angels, hosts, and works summoned to bless Him — 'Bless the LORD, O my soul!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – Clothed with Splendor and Majesty
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Creation hymn: God wrapped in light, stretching the heavens, making the winds His messengers.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – You Set a Boundary for the Waters
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The earth founded, the deep rebuked, and the bounds set that the waters never again cover the earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – Springs in the Valleys
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The flowing springs giving drink to every beast, the birds singing among the branches.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – Wine That Gladdens the Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Providence bringing forth food: wine, oil, and bread to sustain man.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – The Cedars of Lebanon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The well-watered trees, the stork's home, the high mountains for the wild goats and badgers.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – The Moon Marks the Seasons
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ordained rhythm of day and night — lions prowling by dark, man going to his labor till evening.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – In Wisdom You Made Them All
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wonder at the teeming sea where the ships pass and Leviathan frolics.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – You Open Your Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: All creatures depending on God for food and breath; when He sends His Spirit, He renews the earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – He Touches the Mountains and They Smolder
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer that God's glory endure, before whom the earth trembles.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 104 – I Will Sing to the LORD All My Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing vow of praise and the first 'Hallelujah' of the Psalter.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Make Known His Deeds Among the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Salvation-history hymn opens: give thanks, sing, and glory in His holy name.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Seek His Face Always
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Call to remember the wonders and judgments, O offspring of Abraham, His chosen ones.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – He Remembers His Covenant Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: 'I will give you the land of Canaan as your inheritance.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Do Not Touch My Anointed Ones
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's protection of the few wandering patriarchs, rebuking kings on their behalf.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Joseph, Sold as a Slave
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The famine called down and Joseph sent ahead, shackled until the word of the LORD proved him right.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Master of His Household
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Joseph released and made ruler over Egypt, to instruct its princes and elders.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Jacob Dwelt in the Land of Ham
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Israel made fruitful in Egypt, whose hearts God turned to hate His people.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – He Sent Moses and Aaron
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The chosen servants performing His signs and wonders in the land of Ham.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Darkness, Blood, and Frogs
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The plagues recalled: darkness, waters turned to blood, the land teeming with frogs.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Hail and Lightning
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Swarming insects, hail and lightning, the shattered vines and trees of Egypt.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – He Struck All the Firstborn
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The locusts devouring the land and the climactic plague on the firstborn.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Brought Out with Silver and Gold
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Israel led out unstumbling and laden, while the dread of them fell on glad Egypt.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – Bread of Heaven, Water from the Rock
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cloud and fire, the quail and manna, the rock opened to flow like a river.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 105 – That They Might Keep His Statutes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God remembering His promise to Abraham, bringing His people out with joy to inherit the nations — 'Hallelujah!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – His Loving Devotion Endures Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The confessional history opens with praise and a blessing on those who practice righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – Remember Me in Your Favor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The personal plea to share in the prosperity and gladness of God's chosen nation.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – We Have Sinned Like Our Fathers
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The confession begins: the fathers rebelled at the Red Sea, forgetting His abundant kindness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – He Saved Them for His Name's Sake
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Yet He rebuked the Red Sea and led them through the depths; then they believed and sang His praise.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – They Soon Forgot His Works
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Craving in the wilderness, they tested God, who granted their request but sent a wasting disease.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – The Earth Swallowed Dathan
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The envy of Moses and Aaron met by the opening earth and the consuming fire.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – They Made a Calf at Horeb
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Exchanging their Glory for an ox-image (19-22), spared only because Moses stood in the breach (23).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – They Despised the Pleasant Land
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unbelief that grumbled in the tents, provoking the oath to scatter them among the nations.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – Phinehas Stood and Intervened
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Baal of Peor apostasy and plague, restrained by Phinehas, credited to him as righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – The Waters of Meribah
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Rebellion against God's Spirit that brought trouble even on Moses, who spoke rashly.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – They Mingled with the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Failing to drive out the peoples, they adopted their customs and idols, which became a snare.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – Blood of Their Sons and Daughters
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The deepest apostasy: child sacrifice to demons, the land polluted with innocent blood.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – Delivered into the Hand of the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's anger handing His people to their oppressors, who rescued many times yet bent on rebellion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – He Remembered His Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Nevertheless He heard their cry and relented in the abundance of His loving devotion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 106 – Gather Us from the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing plea for ingathering and the doxology that ends Book IV: 'let all the people say, Amen! Hallelujah!'

stories.story_title: Book V – The Hallelujah and Ascent
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Psalms 107–150 gather diverse sub‑collections: thanksgiving for restoration (107), Davidic cluster (108–110), Egyptian Hallel (113–118), the Great Acrostic (119), Songs of Ascents (120–134), and final Hallelujahs (146–150). Ends with Psalm 150 as the doxology for Book V and the entire Psalter. Literary Glue: named sub‑collections and climactic Hallelujah inclusios.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Let the Redeemed Say So
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Book V opens with thanksgiving: the redeemed gathered from every direction called to give thanks for His enduring devotion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Wanderers in the Wasteland
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: First vignette: the lost and hungry who cried out and were led on a straight path to a city.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Satisfies the Thirsty
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The recurring refrain of thanks, with the God who fills the hungry with good things.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Prisoners in Darkness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Second vignette: rebels bound in affliction, humbled with hard labor, with no one to help.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Broke Away Their Chains
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Their cry answered: brought out of the shadow of death, their chains shattered.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Gates of Bronze
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The refrain renewed, with the God who breaks bronze gates and cuts through iron bars.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Sent Forth His Word and Healed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Third vignette: fools near the gates of death, rescued when He sent His word to heal them.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Sacrifices of Thanksgiving
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The refrain with the call to offer thank offerings and declare His works with joy.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – They Saw His Wonders in the Deep
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Fourth vignette: sailors in the tempest, mounting to heaven and sinking to the depths, all skill useless.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Calmed the Storm to a Whisper
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Their cry answered: the hushed waves and the longed-for harbor reached.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Exalt Him in the Assembly
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The final refrain, calling them to praise Him in the council of the elders.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Rivers into Deserts, Deserts into Pools
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wisdom-coda begins: God's reversals over the land for wickedness and for blessing.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Blesses Them and They Multiply
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The hungry settled to build a city, blessed with fruitful harvests and growing herds.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – He Lifts the Needy from Affliction
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Contempt poured on nobles while the needy are raised and their families increase like flocks.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 107 – Let the Wise Consider
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing call: the upright rejoice, and the wise heed the loving devotion of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 108 – My Heart Is Steadfast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A composite Davidic psalm (drawn from Ps 57 and 60): steadfast praise to the God whose devotion is beyond the heavens.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 108 – Be Exalted, O God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The plea that His glory cover the earth and His right hand save His beloved.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 108 – God Has Spoken from His Sanctuary
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The oracle of ownership: Shechem, Gilead, Ephraim, Judah — 'Moab is My washbasin.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 108 – With God We Will Triumph
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Who will lead to Edom? The confession that human help is worthless and only with God comes valor.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – They Repay Evil for Good
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The imprecatory psalm opens: 'O God of my praise, be not silent' against lying tongues that requite love with hatred.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – Let an Accuser Stand at His Right Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The curse invoked on the chief enemy (v. 8 cited of Judas in Acts 1): may his days be few, his children fatherless.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – May His Name Be Blotted Out
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The curse extended: wandering beggar-children, the creditor seizing all, his line cut off.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – May His Sins Remain Before the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Because he never thought to show kindness but hounded the poor and brokenhearted to death.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – The Cursing That He Loved
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Poetic justice: the curse he wore like a coat soaking into his bones, wrapped about him like a robe.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – But You, O GOD, Deal Kindly with Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The turn from the accusers' reward to the psalmist's own plea: 'I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – Fading Like a Lengthening Shadow
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His wasting away — weak knees from fasting, an object of scorn at whom enemies shake their heads.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – Let Them Know This Is Your Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The plea for help that the foes may see God's deliverance — 'though they curse, You will bless.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 109 – He Stands at the Right Hand of the Needy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Accusers clothed in disgrace, and the closing praise of the God who saves the needy one from his condemners.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 110 – Sit at My Right Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The great Messianic enthronement (most-quoted OT verse in the NT): the LORD's word to David's Lord, the scepter from Zion, the dew of His youth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 110 – A Priest Forever After Melchizedek
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unchangeable oath joining king and priest (Heb 7), the Lord crushing kings in the day of His wrath.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 111 – Great Are the Works of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Acrostic praise: whole-hearted thanks in the assembly for His splendid, enduring righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 111 – He Remembers His Covenant Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wonders remembered, food provided for those who fear Him, the nations' inheritance given to His people.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 111 – The Fear of the LORD Is the Beginning of Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His trustworthy precepts and ordained covenant (7-9), sealed by the proverb that opens wisdom (10).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 112 – Blessed Is the Man Who Fears the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Acrostic companion to Ps 111: the God-fearer's mighty offspring and enduring righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 112 – Light Dawns in the Darkness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The gracious, generous man guided by justice, who will never be shaken.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 112 – He Does Not Fear Bad News
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His steadfast, trusting heart and scattered gifts to the poor (7-9), against the wicked who gnash and waste away (10).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 113 – From the Rising of the Sun
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hallel hymn: the name of the LORD praised from sunrise to sunset, now and forevermore.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 113 – Who Is Like the LORD Our God?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The exalted One enthroned on high who humbles Himself to behold heaven and earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 113 – He Raises the Poor from the Dust
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The God who lifts the needy to sit with princes and settles the barren woman as a joyful mother.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 114 – The Sea Looked and Fled
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Exodus hymn: when Israel left Egypt, the sea fled, the Jordan turned back, the mountains skipped like rams.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 114 – Tremble, O Earth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The taunting questions to sea and mountains, ending in the rock turned to a pool of water.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 115 – Not to Us, but to Your Name
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The glory ascribed to God alone — 'our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 115 – Their Idols Have Mouths but Cannot Speak
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The satire on lifeless idols and their makers who become like them.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 115 – Trust in the LORD, He Is Their Shield
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The threefold call to Israel, the house of Aaron, and the God-fearers to trust their help and shield.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 115 – The LORD Is Mindful of Us
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The blessing pronounced on small and great, from the Maker of heaven and earth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 115 – It Is We Who Will Bless the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Earth given to mankind; not the silent dead but the living bless the LORD forevermore.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – I Love the LORD, for He Heard My Voice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Thanksgiving opens: because He inclined His ear, 'I will call on Him as long as I live.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – The Ropes of Death Entangled Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The remembered distress and the simple cry: 'O LORD, deliver my soul!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – Return to Your Rest, O My Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The gracious and compassionate LORD who saved the helpless, calling the soul back to rest.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – I Will Walk Before the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Delivered from death, tears, and stumbling, to walk in the land of the living.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – I Believed, Therefore I Spoke
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The faith that spoke even in affliction and alarm (cited by Paul in 2 Cor 4).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – The Cup of Salvation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: How to repay the LORD — lifting the cup of salvation and fulfilling vows before His people.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – Precious Is the Death of His Saints
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The worth of His saints in His sight, and the servant whose bonds He has broken.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 116 – A Sacrifice of Thanksgiving
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Vows paid in the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of Jerusalem — 'Hallelujah!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 117 – Praise the LORD, All You Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The shortest psalm, complete: all peoples summoned to praise His great and enduring love.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – His Loving Devotion Endures Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Egyptian-Hallel processional opens with the fourfold antiphon of Israel, Aaron, and the God-fearers.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – The LORD Is on My Side
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Set free in distress — 'what can man do to me?' — looking in triumph on those who hate him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – Better to Take Refuge in the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The twin proverbs at the very center of the Psalter: better the LORD than man, than princes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – In the Name of the LORD I Cut Them Off
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The nations swarming like bees, extinguished like burning thorns in the name of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – The LORD Is My Strength and My Song
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pushed hard and falling, but helped — the Exodus refrain of Moses now his own.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – The Right Hand of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The shout in the tents of the righteous celebrating the valorous, exalted right hand of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – I Will Not Die, but Live
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The resurrection-toned vow to live and proclaim the LORD's works, disciplined but not given to death.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – Open to Me the Gates of Righteousness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The entrance liturgy at the temple gate through which the righteous enter to give thanks.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – The Stone the Builders Rejected
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cornerstone-prophecy applied to Christ, and 'this is the day that the LORD has made.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – Blessed Is He Who Comes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Hosanna cry and the Palm-Sunday blessing, the festal sacrifice bound to the altar.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 118 – You Are My God; I Will Exalt You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing vow of praise, returning to the opening antiphon of His enduring devotion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Aleph: Blessed Are the Blameless
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Acrostic on God's word opens: blessed are those who walk in the Law of the LORD and keep His testimonies.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Aleph: Oh, That My Ways Were Steadfast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The longing to keep His statutes unashamed, with an upright heart — 'do not utterly forsake me.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Beth: How Can a Young Man Keep His Way Pure?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: By guarding it according to God's word and hiding it in the heart against sin.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Beth: I Delight in Your Statutes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Rejoicing in the way of His testimonies as in all riches, meditating and not forgetting His word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Gimel: Open My Eyes to Wondrous Things
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The sojourner's plea to see the wonders of God's law, his soul consumed with longing.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Gimel: Your Testimonies Are My Counselors
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Though rulers slander him, the servant meditates on statutes that are his delight and counsel.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Daleth: Revive Me According to Your Word
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The soul cleaving to dust, melting with sorrow, pleading for strength from God's word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Daleth: I Run the Path of Your Commandments
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Choosing the way of truth and clinging to His testimonies as God enlarges the heart.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – He: Teach Me, and I Will Keep It to the End
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer for understanding and an obedient heart, turned to His testimonies, not covetous gain.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – He: Turn My Eyes from Worthless Things
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Turning the eyes from vanity, longing for revival in His righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Waw: Your Salvation According to Your Promise
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer for God's devotion so he can answer the taunter, trusting and obeying His word forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Waw: I Will Walk in Freedom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Walking at liberty, speaking of His testimonies before kings, lifting hands to the commandments he loves.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Zayin: Your Word Is My Comfort in Affliction
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The promise that gives life, his comfort under the derision of the arrogant.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Zayin: Your Statutes Are My Songs
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Indignation at the wicked, yet His statutes become songs in the house of his pilgrimage.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Heth: The LORD Is My Portion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Seeking His face with all his heart, turning his steps and hurrying to keep His commandments.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Heth: At Midnight I Rise to Thank You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Unforgetting of the law though bound by the wicked, a friend to all who fear God.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Teth: You Are Good and Do Good
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Confidence in God's goodness — 'teach me good judgment,' for affliction taught him to keep His word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Teth: Better Than Thousands of Gold and Silver
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Despite the lies of the arrogant, the law of God's mouth is more precious than all wealth.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Yodh: Your Hands Have Made Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Creator-plea for understanding, that those who fear God may rejoice to see him hope in His word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Yodh: Let My Heart Be Blameless
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Compassion sought against the shaming arrogant, that his heart be blameless in God's statutes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Kaph: My Soul Faints for Your Salvation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Failing eyes waiting for the promise — 'when will You comfort me?' — like a wineskin dried by smoke.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Kaph: Revive Me, for I Have Not Forsaken You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Almost wiped from the earth by the arrogant's pits, yet clinging to His precepts.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Lamedh: Your Word Is Forever, Fixed in Heaven
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The everlasting word and faithfulness that established the earth — the delight that saved him from perishing.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Lamedh: I Am Yours; Save Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Never forgetting the precepts by which he was revived, for His commandment is without limit.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Mem: Oh, How I Love Your Law!
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: All-day meditation that makes him wiser than enemies, teachers, and elders.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Mem: Sweeter Than Honey to My Mouth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Feet kept from evil, His words sweeter than honey, giving understanding to hate every false way.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Nun: A Lamp to My Feet
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The most famous verse: His word a lamp and light; the oath to keep His righteous judgments.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Nun: Your Testimonies Are My Heritage
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Life constantly in his hands, yet His testimonies the joy of his heart and his heritage forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Samekh: You Are My Hiding Place and Shield
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hating the double-minded, hoping in His word, pleading to be sustained and not put to shame.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Samekh: My Flesh Trembles in Awe
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wicked discarded like dross, and the holy fear that makes his flesh tremble before God's judgments.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Ayin: Do Not Leave Me to My Oppressors
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pleading on the ground of his integrity, eyes failing as he looks for God's righteous salvation.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Ayin: I Love Your Commandments More Than Gold
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'It is time for the LORD to act'; loving His precepts above purest gold and hating every false way.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Pe: The Unfolding of Your Words Gives Light
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wonderful testimonies that light the simple; panting with longing for His commandments.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Pe: Streams of Tears for Your Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Steps ordered by His word, redeemed from oppression, weeping that His law is not obeyed.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Tsadhe: Righteous Are You, O LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The upright judgments and pure promise that the consumed-with-zeal servant loves.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Tsadhe: Your Righteousness Is Everlasting
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Lowly and despised, yet not forgetting precepts whose righteousness endures forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Qoph: I Rise Before Dawn and Cry for Help
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Calling with the whole heart, anticipating the night-watches to meditate on His word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Qoph: You Are Near, O LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wicked drawing near, but God nearer still, His commandments established forever.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Resh: Defend My Cause and Revive Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pleading for rescue from affliction, for great are the mercies of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Resh: The Entirety of Your Word Is Truth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Unturned from His testimonies despite many foes — 'the entirety of Your word is truth.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Shin: Seven Times a Day I Praise You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His heart fearing God's word more than rulers, rejoicing in it like one who finds great spoil.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Shin: Great Peace Have They Who Love Your Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unstumbling peace of those who love His law; waiting for salvation and obeying His testimonies.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Taw: Let My Cry Come Before You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing strophe: lips and tongue pouring forth praise as God teaches His righteous word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 119 – Taw: I Have Strayed Like a Lost Sheep
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The final note of longing and humility — 'seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 120 – Deliver Me from Lying Lips
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: First Song of Ascents: distress answered, the deceitful tongue judged by the warrior's arrows and coals.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 120 – Too Long Among Those Who Hate Peace
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The pilgrim's lament of exile in Meshech and Kedar: 'I am for peace… but they want war.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 121 – My Help Comes from the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The keeper-psalm: help from the Maker of heaven and earth, who neither slumbers nor sleeps.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 121 – The LORD Will Watch Over Your Going Out
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The shade on the right hand who guards from all evil, watching your coming and going forevermore.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 122 – I Was Glad When They Said, Let Us Go
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The pilgrim's joy at standing within Jerusalem's gates, the city knit firmly together.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 122 – The Thrones of the House of David
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Where the tribes go up to give thanks and the thrones of judgment stand.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 122 – Pray for the Peace of Jerusalem
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer for the city's peace and prosperity, for the sake of brothers and the house of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 123 – Eyes Lifted to the Enthroned One
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm: eyes lifted like a servant's to a master's hand, pleading mercy amid the contempt of the proud.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 124 – If the LORD Had Not Been on Our Side
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The pilgrim's 'what-if': had not the LORD been with us, the flood and raging waters would have swept us away.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 124 – Escaped Like a Bird from the Snare
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Blessing the LORD who tore the fowler's net — 'our help is in the name of the LORD, Maker of heaven and earth.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 125 – Those Who Trust Are Like Mount Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm: the unmovable trust surrounded by the LORD as mountains surround Jerusalem; 'Peace be upon Israel.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 126 – Those Who Sow in Tears
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm: the dreamlike restoration of Zion (1-3) and the harvest promise — sowing in tears, reaping with joy (4-6).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 127 – Unless the LORD Builds the House
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete Solomonic ascent-psalm: the vanity of labor without God (1-2) and children as a heritage, arrows in the warrior's hand (3-5).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 128 – Blessed Are All Who Fear the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm: domestic blessing — the fruitful vine, olive-shoot sons, and Zion's prosperity; 'Peace be upon Israel!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 129 – Greatly They Have Afflicted Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The afflicted-from-youth refrain: plowed-over back, yet 'they have not prevailed,' for the LORD cut the cords.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 129 – Like Grass on the Rooftops
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wish that Zion's haters wither like rooftop grass, ungathered and unblessed.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 130 – Out of the Depths I Cry
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The de profundis: if God kept a record of sins none could stand, 'but with You there is forgiveness.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 130 – More Than Watchmen Wait for the Morning
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Waiting for the LORD with hope, for with Him is abundant redemption from all iniquity.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 131 – Like a Weaned Child
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm of humility: a heart not proud, a soul stilled like a weaned child; 'O Israel, hope in the LORD.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – David's Oath to Find a Place for the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ascent-psalm of the ark: remembering David's vow not to rest until he found a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – Arise, O LORD, to Your Resting Place
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The procession recalling the ark found in the fields of Jaar, summoning God to His resting place.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – For the Sake of Your Servant David
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The prayer that priests be clothed with righteousness and the anointed not be rejected.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – The LORD Swore an Oath to David
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unbreakable promise of a descendant on the throne, conditioned on covenant-keeping sons.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – The LORD Has Chosen Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's own word: 'This is My resting place forever… here I will dwell.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – I Will Satisfy Her Poor with Bread
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The blessing on Zion's provision and her priests clothed with salvation.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 132 – A Horn for David, a Lamp for My Anointed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The promise of a growing horn and a prepared lamp, his enemies clothed with shame.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 133 – How Good When Brothers Dwell in Unity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Complete ascent-psalm: unity like Aaron's anointing oil and Hermon's dew, where the LORD bestows life forevermore.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 134 – Bless the LORD, You Servants of the Night
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The final ascent-psalm: night-watch servants blessing the LORD, answered by His blessing from Zion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – Praise the Name of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hallel hymn: servants in His house praising the LORD who chose Jacob as His treasured possession.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – He Does All That Pleases Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The great LORD above all gods, who raises clouds, makes lightning, and brings wind from His storehouses.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – He Struck Down the Firstborn of Egypt
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Salvation-history recalled: the plagues, the fallen kings Sihon and Og, and the inheritance given to Israel.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – Your Name Endures Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His everlasting renown, vindicating His people and showing compassion on His servants.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – Idols of Silver and Gold
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The satire on lifeless idols and their makers who become as deaf and breathless as they.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 135 – Bless the LORD, O House of Israel
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fourfold summons of Israel, Aaron, Levi, and the God-fearers to bless the LORD from Zion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – His Loving Devotion Endures Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Great Hallel opens with its antiphon: thanks to the God of gods who alone does great wonders.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – He Made the Heavens by His Insight
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Creation recalled with the refrain: the spread earth, the sun, moon, and stars set to rule.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – He Brought Israel Out
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Exodus by mighty hand and outstretched arm, after striking Egypt's firstborn.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – He Divided the Red Sea
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Israel led through the parted waters that swept away Pharaoh and his army.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – Through the Wilderness, Striking Kings
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wilderness journey and the defeat of great and mighty kings, with the refrain.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – Sihon and Og, Their Land an Inheritance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The named kings overthrown and their land given as a heritage to Israel.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 136 – He Remembered Us in Our Low Estate
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing thanks: He freed us, feeds every creature — 'give thanks to the God of heaven.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 137 – By the Rivers of Babylon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The exile's lament: harps hung on the willows, tormentors demanding a song of Zion.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 137 – If I Forget You, O Jerusalem
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The oath of remembrance — let hand and tongue fail if Jerusalem is not the chief joy.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 137 – O Daughter of Babylon, Doomed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The imprecation against Edom and Babylon, ending in the terrible blessing of recompense.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 138 – I Give You Thanks with All My Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: David's thanksgiving before the gods, bowing toward the temple for God's exalted word.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 138 – All the Kings of the Earth Will Thank You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The nations' coming praise, for the exalted LORD attends to the lowly but knows the proud from afar.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 138 – The LORD Will Fulfill His Purpose for Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Preserved in the midst of trouble — 'do not abandon the works of Your hands.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – You Have Searched Me and Known Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The psalm of God's omniscience opens: He knows every thought, path, and word before it is spoken.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Such Knowledge Is Too Wonderful
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hemmed in behind and before, the psalmist marvels at a knowledge too lofty to attain.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Where Can I Flee from Your Presence?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's omnipresence: in the heavens, in Sheol, on the wings of the dawn, His hand still guides.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Darkness Is as Light to You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Even darkness cannot hide, for to God the night shines like the day.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Fearfully and Wonderfully Made
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God knitting him together in the womb — marvelous works the soul knows full well.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Written in Your Book
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unformed body seen, all his days ordained and written before one came to be.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – How Vast Is the Sum of Your Thoughts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: God's precious thoughts outnumbering the sand — 'when I awake, I am still with You.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – I Hate Them with Perfect Hatred
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The turn against the bloodthirsty who take God's name in vain, counted as the psalmist's own enemies.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 139 – Search Me and Lead Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing surrender: 'see if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 140 – Rescue Me from Men of Violence
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Lament against the violent who sharpen tongues like snakes, viper's venom on their lips; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 140 – The Proud Have Hidden a Snare
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Plea to be guarded from the wicked who set a net and lures along the path; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 140 – You Are My God; Hear My Cry
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Confidence in the strength of his salvation, asking that the wicked's desires not be granted; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 140 – May Burning Coals Fall on Them
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The imprecation: the trouble of their lips recoiling, calamity hunting down the man of violence.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 140 – The LORD Upholds the Cause of the Needy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing confidence: the righteous will praise His name and dwell in His presence.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 141 – Let My Prayer Be Like Incense
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Evening prayer: the cry to come quickly, the uplifted hands like the evening offering.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 141 – Set a Guard Over My Mouth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The plea against an evil heart drawn to wickedness and the delicacies of the wicked.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 141 – Let the Righteous Strike Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Welcoming a righteous rebuke as oil for the head, amid scattered bones at the mouth of Sheol.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 141 – My Eyes Are Fixed on You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Seeking refuge from the snares laid for him, that the wicked fall into their own nets while he passes safely.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 142 – I Pour Out My Complaint Before Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cave-prayer: crying aloud and revealing his trouble to the God who knows his way amid hidden snares.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 142 – You Are My Refuge in the Land of the Living
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No one caring for his soul, he clings to God — 'free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – No One Alive Is Righteous Before You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Penitential prayer (the seventh): pleading God's faithfulness, not judgment, for none living is righteous.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – Crushed to the Ground
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The enemy pressing his life into darkness, his spirit faint and heart dismayed.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – I Remember the Days of Old
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Meditation on God's past works, his soul thirsting for Him like a parched land; Selah.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – Let Me Hear Your Devotion in the Morning
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Urgent plea for an answer and for direction — 'teach me the way I should walk.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – Teach Me to Do Your Will
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Fleeing to God for refuge, asking His good Spirit to lead on level ground.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 143 – Revive Me for Your Name's Sake
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing appeal to God's righteousness and devotion to bring his soul out of trouble.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 144 – My Rock Who Trains My Hands for War
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: David's praise of the LORD his fortress, deliverer, and shield who subdues peoples under him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 144 – What Is Man, That You Regard Him?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wonder at God's care for fleeting man, whose days are like a passing shadow.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 144 – Part Your Heavens and Come Down
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The theophany-plea for lightning and rescue from the deep waters and deceitful foreigners.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 144 – I Will Sing a New Song
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Praise to the God who gives victory to kings, with the renewed plea for rescue from lying foes.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 144 – Blessed Are the People Whose God Is the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The vision of national flourishing — thriving children, full storehouses, peace in the streets — and its beatitude.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – I Will Exalt You, My God and King
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The great acrostic of praise opens: daily blessing of the unsearchably great LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – One Generation Will Commend Your Works
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The handing-down of His mighty acts, majesty, and abundant goodness from age to age.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – The LORD Is Good to All
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Exodus-creed widened: gracious, compassionate, good to all, His mercy over all He has made.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – Your Kingdom Is an Everlasting Kingdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: All His works giving thanks, telling of the glory and everlasting dominion of His kingdom.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – You Open Your Hand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The LORD upholding all who fall, opening His hand to satisfy the desire of every living thing.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 145 – The LORD Is Near to All Who Call
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Righteous in all His ways, near to all who call in truth (17-20), sealed by the vow that every creature bless His name (21).

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 146 – Praise the LORD, O My Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The first of the closing Hallelujah psalms: lifelong praise to God while life lasts.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 146 – Put Not Your Trust in Princes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The vanity of mortal help, whose plans perish on the day his spirit departs.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 146 – Blessed Is He Whose Help Is the God of Jacob
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Maker who keeps faith forever, executes justice, feeds the hungry, frees the prisoners.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 146 – The LORD Reigns Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Opening blind eyes, lifting the bowed, sustaining the orphan and widow — 'the LORD reigns forever, O Zion.'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – He Heals the Brokenhearted
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hallelujah for the God who builds Jerusalem, gathers the exiles, and binds up wounds.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – He Numbers the Stars
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Naming each star, infinite in understanding, He sustains the humble and casts the wicked down.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – He Provides for the Ravens
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Thanksgiving for the God who clothes the sky with clouds, grows the grass, and feeds the young ravens.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – The LORD Delights in Those Who Fear Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Not the horse's strength but the hope of His worshipers pleases Him.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – Praise Your God, O Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Jerusalem to exalt the LORD who strengthens her gates, blesses her children, and gives the finest wheat.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – He Sends Forth His Word
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His swift word commanding snow like wool and frost like ashes, then melting them with His breath.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 147 – He Declares His Word to Jacob
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unique privilege of Israel, to whom alone He revealed His statutes — 'Hallelujah!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 148 – Praise the LORD from the Heavens
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cosmic doxology summons angels, hosts, sun, moon, stars, and the highest heavens.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 148 – He Commanded and They Were Created
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Let them praise His name, for He established them forever by an unpassing decree.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 148 – Praise the LORD from the Earth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The summons widens to sea creatures, weather, mountains, trees, beasts, and birds.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 148 – Kings and All Peoples
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Earth's rulers, young and old, men and maidens, called into the chorus.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 148 – His Splendor Above Earth and Heaven
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: All to praise the exalted name, for He has raised a horn for His people near to Him — 'Hallelujah!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 149 – Sing to the LORD a New Song
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hallelujah for Zion's King: praise with dancing, tambourine, and harp in the assembly of the godly.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 149 – The High Praises of God in Their Mouths
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The LORD's pleasure in His people, the saints exulting with praise and a double-edged sword.

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 149 – The Judgment Written
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The saints' honor to execute the written judgment on the nations and their kings — 'Hallelujah!'

scenes.scene_name: Psalm 150 – Let Everything That Has Breath Praise the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The grand doxology closing the Psalter: praise in His sanctuary and mighty heavens, with every instrument, by everything that breathes — 'Hallelujah!'
